description: This file implements an Angular service named UiStoreService that manages UI layout state using RxJS BehaviorSubjects. It provides observables for sidebar open state and active route, along with methods to modify these states.

classes.name: UiStoreService
classes.description: An Angular service for managing UI state, including sidebar visibility and active route, using RxJS BehaviorSubjects for reactive updates.

methods.name: setSidebarOpen
methods.description: Sets the sidebar open state to the specified boolean value.

methods.name: toggleSidebar
methods.description: Toggles the sidebar open state between true and false.

methods.name: setActiveRoute
methods.description: Sets the active route string for UI purposes.
